notes.title: Update v1.2
notes.content:
[h1]Hello again and happy new year everyone! Here is what's new in the v1.2 update:[/h1]


[b]• Steam Achievements:[/b] Complete challenges and show off your achievements to your friends!
[b]• Steam Leaderboard:[/b] Compete against players worldwide and strive to be the #1 player in various areas of the game!
[b]• Night Reworked:[/b] The hunter is no longer slowed when shooting at night. Wolves now transform more slowly but can hear the hunter’s heartbeat periodically. Hopefully, these changes will make nights more exciting!
• Prey now gets hungry [u]faster[/u].
[b]• Brightstone Reworked to Savannah:[/b] The town named "Brightstone" didn’t fit the map's atmosphere, so it’s been replaced.



[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
• Fixed a bug that caused grass to grow inside shelters.
• Fixed a bug that caused glitchy screen tearing with some GPUs after changing the game resolution.
• Fixed a bug that prevented waypoints from appearing for some clients.
• Addressed some minor issues.


If you would like to discuss the game or team up with others, join our community on [url=https://discord.com/invite/deKFenpnGV]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Update v1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone! I'm back with a small update, v1.1. Here's what's new:[/h1]
•	[b]Quest System for Prey:[/b] Prey can now find and accept one of 18 random quests each round, these quests can be easy, medium, or hard (it's also random). Completing a quest rewards all living prey with Special Food Coins, but failing it gives the hunter bonus cash!
•	[b]Wildlife Changes:[/b] Lions and crocodiles are less aggressive now.
•	[b]Explosive Trap Adjustment:[/b] Hunters now receive only 3 traps instead of 5 when purchasing them.
•	[b]Fox Adjustment:[/b] Fox is more expensive now and does not reward the hunter with bonus cash when it kills a Prey.

[b]What’s the plan moving forward?[/b]
As I continue fixing bugs here and there, my focus will shift toward adding exciting new content. This includes a new map with its own spin, Steam achievements, and reworking the night phase to make it even more engaging. I want the updates to feel meaningful, with enough new features to surprise you and make coming back to the game worthwhile.

Want to chat about the game or team up with others? Join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/deKFenpnGV]Discord[/url]!
